headersPlaceholder: One per line, in the format Key: Value
successPlaceholder: One per line; the request succeeds if the response contains any of them. Leave empty to check only for a 2xx status code
proxyHelp: Reach the callback URL through a proxy when it is not directly reachable. Supports http://, https:// and socks5://. Without a proxy, HTTPS_PROXY and similar environment variables apply.
